summary: Iteration 6 RETEST of two iteration-5 regressions: (1) Dashboard Interview History per-user filter via localStorage 'interviewSessionIds', and (2) ResultsPage dark-theme contrast. Both fixes are now VERIFIED PASS. Fresh-browser /dashboard shows 0% / 0 / 0 history rows with the empty-state CTA visible; injecting a known evaluated session id renders exactly 1 history row with correct stats. /results cards now use bg-slate-800/60 + text-white/purple-200/slate-300 — all key labels measured as light/readable on the dark gradient. One pre-existing minor: the Proctoring Analysis card on /results still uses light pastel surfaces (bg-emerald-50 / text-slate-800), unchanged from iter 5.

minor.issue: Slow response (~28s) when called fresh — caused initial Playwright wait_for_selector timeouts on Dashboard. Not a regression, but worth flagging for product (cache or pagination).

critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx now has a single source of truth (`completedHistory`) for both stats and history list — the duplicate IIFE filter from iter 5 is gone. Good.
Dashboard.jsx still silently catches localStorage parse errors twice (lines 84 and 91-93). Consolidating into one try/catch and at least console.warn would improve maintainability.
Dashboard.jsx computes mySessionIds and avgScore in two places that both read localStorage — could memo it via useMemo once at the top of the render.

ResultsPage.jsx Proctoring Analysis Card (lines 116-220) is the LAST light-mode island on the page — recommend a follow-up to convert bg-{emerald,amber,rose}-50 → bg-{...}-500/10 and text-slate-700/800 → text-{...}-100/300 for consistency.

ResultsPage.jsx getScoreColor still returns Tailwind semantic tokens (text-accent, text-destructive) that aren't defined for the dark theme — on the dark background the 63% renders orange (text-orange-500). Acceptable, but worth aligning with the new dark palette.

/api/analytics/history is ~28s cold. Frontend Dashboard.jsx awaits it via Promise.all before showing any content; consider rendering analytics + history independently or adding a skeleton state so the page is interactive sooner.

rca of the issue: Resolved. Iter 5 root cause was a duplicate IIFE filter inside the Interview History Card that ignored mySessionIds. Iter 6 confirms Dashboard.jsx now reuses the outer `completedHistory` (filtered with mySessionIds.includes(s.id) && answers.length>0 && evaluated_at) for both the empty-state branch and the row map. ResultsPage Card surfaces were switched to bg-slate-800/60 + text-white/purple-200/slate-300, and progress bar tracks to bg-slate-700/60 — verified via computed-style snapshots.
